title: Inline @ mention pills for papers in every composer (TipTap)
description:
User feedback on 2026-10-10: "removing @Han 18 doesn't remove the attachment. Instead of text can we have the @ thing like an entity inside a pill or something like that?" Today, typing @ inserts plain text '@Surname Year' into a textarea while the paper is attached separately, so deleting the text leaves the attachment. The server recognises named papers by literal text matching. The user chose TipTap (headless ProseMirror with the official Mention extension) over Lexical or a hand-built contenteditable.
Implemented on 2026-10-10 on feat/ara-096-mention-pills. The composer is a TipTap 3.31.4 editor (document, paragraph, text, hard break, UndoRedo, Placeholder and the official Mention node with @tiptap/suggestion; no starter kit). Typing @ at the start of a word opens the existing PaperPicker; the paper picked becomes an atomic pill (file icon and 'Surname Year') with role img, aria-roledescription 'paper' and the paper's citation as its name. Home and new chats choose the papers their pills mention plus those added with the @ button; in a chat a mentioned paper stays a pill until the question is sent with structured mentions, and the server adds it in the transaction that stores the question. Decisions beyond the plan: a picker closed without a pick leaves the typed @ as text (before, @ was swallowed); removing a paper from an existing chat also removes its pills from the draft, as removing a chip does on home, so sending does not add it back; mention spans count Unicode code points, as Python indexes strings. No migration: mentions live in chat_messages.configuration.
Follow-up on 2026-10-10 (user decision): "We can have them only as inline pills without the chips on top. However, then hovering them should highlight and show the remove cross at right top corner and also the inline pill should have the title not Han 18 type of thing. Also hovering should reveal the short citation." Built on the same branch after merging feat/ux-feedback-round: the home and new-chat composers lost their chip rows and the @ button inserts a pill at the caret (or the end) in every composer; pills show the title (also their label in the question text), cut near 28ch, with the attached-PDF icon; a shared PaperPill (React node view in the editor, selectable) highlights on hover or node selection with a round remove button at its top right, and opens a HoverCard with PaperCitation and the full title when cut. The chat's own paper row in existing chats is unchanged. A browser round fixed a picker race, focus timing after a pick and the history pill's surface.
acceptance_criteria: Given any composer (home, new chat, chat), when the user types @ and picks a paper, then an atomic inline pill (icon plus 'Surname Year' or a short title) is inserted where @ was typed.

Given a pill, when the user deletes it (Backspace, Delete, a selection or cut), then it is removed as one unit. A paper that the pill brought into the draft is no longer attached unless another pill or an explicit chip still references it.

Given an existing chat, when the user mentions a paper not yet in the chat, then it is added only when the message is sent, atomically with that message and idempotent per request UUID. Deleting the pill before sending leaves the chat unchanged.

Given an existing chat, when the user mentions a paper already in it, then the question is focused on that paper. Deleting the pill does not remove the paper from the chat; removal stays with the chip ×, the '+N more' list or the toolbar picker.
Given a sent message, when history renders, then its mentions show as the same non-editable pills, and the server receives structured mentioned paper IDs instead of relying on '@Surname Year' text.

Given the composer, when the user types, then today's behaviour holds: Enter sends, Shift+Enter adds a line, IME composition works, plain-text paste works, autosize, placeholder, disabled states and the context meter. Screen readers announce pills, and keyboard users can move over and delete them.
Given the frontend bundle, when TipTap is added, then only the needed extensions are installed (no starter-kit bloat), with exact lockfile versions and licenses recorded.
Given the home or new-chat composer, when papers are mentioned, then no chip row appears above the question: the pills are the attachments, and a paper leaves with its last pill.
Given any composer, when the @ button picks a paper, then a pill goes at the caret the question had, or at the end when it had no focus; nothing is added to an existing chat before sending.
Given a pill, then it shows a file icon and the paper's title on one line, cut with an ellipsis near 28 characters, a step smaller than the composer text and on its baseline.

Given a pill in the composer, when it is hovered or selected as a node, then it highlights and shows a round remove button at its top right named "Remove <title>"; pressing it removes the pill as Backspace does and keeps focus in the editor.

Given a pill hovered for about 300 ms or selected, then a card shows its short citation and, when the pill cuts the title, the full title; it does not flicker on the way to the remove button and closes on Escape and blur; a paper without citation details and with a title that fits opens no card.
Given a sent question, then its pills show the same title and card but no remove button, and stand apart from the bubble.
Given a screen reader, then a pill is named by its title and described by its citation, once.
test_cases: Unit and component: pill insertion, atomic deletion syncing attachments, duplicate mentions, paste, Enter and Shift+Enter, IME guard, accessibility labels.
Backend: send with mentioned paper IDs adds missing papers atomically and idempotently; named-paper routing uses the IDs.
Playwright spec for typing @, picking, deleting a pill and sending, run at integration.
PaperPill: name, description, truncation, hover and selected remove button, focus kept, card with full title, Escape, no empty card, history variant (PaperPill.test.tsx).
Composer: title pills, remove button and node selection, @ button at the caret or the end (Composer.test.tsx); late picker close (use-paper-mention.test.ts).
No chip row in home and new chat; @ button pills; chat removal through the chat's paper row; history pills (App.test.tsx, multi-paper.test.tsx, mention-pills.test.tsx).
Server accepts a title label with punctuation and accents (test_chat_mentions.py).
verification: Isolated Compose project ara-pills-test; the user's ara and ara-live stacks were not touched. Baseline: backend 1083 passed, Ruff clean; frontend npm run check 618 tests in 80 files. Final: python3 scripts/test-stack.py test --project-name ara-pills-test: Ruff clean, 1094 passed in 232.66 s (one @-text test removed, 12 added). npm run check: typecheck and lint clean, 637 tests in 82 files passed; one of two final runs under heavy machine load (79 s against a 35 s baseline) timed out the first, cold workspace test, which takes the same 1.0-1.5 s alone on the baseline and on this branch. npm run build passed with the existing chunk-size warning: main chunk 466.25 -> 811.37 kB (gzip 140.69 -> 247.94 kB), CSS 125.74 -> 126.43 kB. generated.ts regenerated from the flag-on app.openapi(); the diff is only PaperMention, ChatInput.mentions and Message.mentions. Evidence per criterion: pills, atomic Backspace/Delete/selection/cut, paste, limit, IME, Enter/Shift+Enter, accessibility (Composer.test.tsx); pill-only versus explicit papers, duplicate pills, chip removal (App.test.tsx, multi-paper.test.tsx); send-time add and nothing added while drafting, already-included papers kept, history pills, citations of a just-added paper (multi-paper.test.tsx, mention-pills.test.tsx); atomic, validated, idempotent server add, replay without regeneration, 409 on a changed replay, rollback on refusal, routing by id, local-model refusal (test_chat_mentions.py, test_chat_mentions_integration.py). Not run: the Playwright specs e2e/mention-pills.spec.ts and the updated e2e/multi-paper.spec.ts (by instruction). Not verified: a visual check in a browser, real IME input, mobile virtual keyboards and actual screen reader output. Follow-up (after merging feat/ux-feedback-round 30e53be): python3 scripts/test-stack.py test --project-name ara-pills-test: Ruff clean, 1193 passed in 266.91 s. npm run check: 678 tests in 87 files; npm run build passed with the existing chunk-size warning; main chunk 742.77 -> 758.51 kB (gzip 224.56 -> 228.97 kB), CSS 130.05 -> 131.99 kB. Visual round in Playwright's Chromium against a temporary Vite harness with stubbed API data, light, dark and 390 px: pills 20 px tall at 13 px on the 15 px composer line, no horizontal overflow at 390 px, pills wrap whole; found and fixed a late picker close dismissing the next @ (3 of 8 runs, then 0 of 8), focus returning about 50 ms after a pick, and history pills blending into the bubble. Not run: the Playwright specs; not verified: touch devices, real IME, screen reader output.
